description: P2-d cross-language contract: the enclave authority policy (apply_enrollment_intent, authority.rs) rejects a Carry target blob whose PLAINTEXT already carries a non-null recoveryEmail/recoveryLanguage — on carry the enclave always fills those fields in from the source blob instead — but accepts the identical blob shape for Enroll/Replace (where the signed intent is required to bind a matching contact instead). Rust (policy/authority/tests.rs) builds and submits a real target blob with each case's fields and asserts apply_enrollment_intent's accept/reject outcome through the real enclave policy; TypeScript (escrow-authority.test.ts) asserts the same outcome via resolveEscrowEnrollmentAction plus the same rule the enclave enforces. Each case is independent: did/shareVersion/epoch are illustrative, not cross-referenced. recoveryEmail/recoveryLanguage are always both-null or both-set, matching the blob plaintext's own format invariant.

cases.name: enroll accepts a target with contact fields
replace accepts a target with contact fields
carry rejects a target that already carries contact fields
carry accepts a target with no contact fields
